item.title: Commit and deploy configuration changes for a Worker Group
item.description:
Guides › Examples › Configuration & Deployment

Commit and deploy configuration changes for a Worker Group#

Cribl.Cloud example_cloud_commit_deploy.py

This example is for Cribl.Cloud deployments only.

Prerequisites#

  • pip install cribl-python-sdk
  • CRIBL_CLIENT_ID and CRIBL_CLIENT_SECRET env vars (OAuth2 API credentials)
  • CRIBL_CLOUD_URL env var (workspace URL)
  • A Worker Group with pending changes

Environment variables#

Variable Default
CRIBL_CLIENT_ID your-client-id
CRIBL_CLIENT_SECRET your-client-secret
CRIBL_CLOUD_URL https://main-your-org.cribl.cloud
CRIBL_WORKER_GROUP_ID default

Code#

item.description:
Guides › Examples › Configuration & Deployment

Configure Resources#

Cribl.Cloud example_cloud_configure_resources.py

Create source, destination, pipeline, route in a Worker Group.

This example is for Cribl.Cloud deployments only.

Prerequisites#

  • pip install cribl-python-sdk
  • CRIBL_CLIENT_ID and CRIBL_CLIENT_SECRET env vars
  • CRIBL_CLOUD_URL env var
  • AWS credentials for the S3 destination

Environment variables#

Variable Default
CRIBL_CLIENT_ID your-client-id
CRIBL_CLIENT_SECRET your-client-secret
CRIBL_CLOUD_URL https://main-your-org.cribl.cloud
CRIBL_WORKER_GROUP_ID my-group
AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID your-aws-key
AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY your-aws-secret
AWS_BUCKET_NAME your-bucket
AWS_REGION us-east-2
